title: Problem
问题
html:
Small orchestrators need explicit tasks and evaluation criteria to learn when to invoke expensive models or tools rather than always selecting the strongest option.

ToolScale serializes difficult tool-routing scenarios with initial state and evaluation actions, supplying the task substrate for ToolOrchestra training. The decision boundary is whether a serialized record survives environment evaluation criteria plus outcome, efficiency, and user-preference rewards; the direct output is ToolScale, consumed by reinforcement learning and task-conditioned orchestration training rather than an evaluation-only benchmark.

L4 facts: primary source arXiv:2511.21689; venue/date arXiv preprint (2025); open data ToolScale at https://huggingface.co/datasets/nvidia/ToolScale; scale 4,063 synthetic tool-orchestration tasks; full paper, official README, terms, schema, and one actual record checked on 2026-07-27.

小型编排器需要明确任务与评估标准，才能学习何时调用昂贵模型或工具，而不是始终选择最强选项。

该数据集把困难路由场景序列化为初始状态与评估动作，为兼顾结果、效率和用户偏好的训练提供底板。 判定边界是记录能否通过“环境评估条件以及结果、效率和用户偏好奖励”并成为强化学习与任务条件化工具编排训练的输入；直接产物是 ToolScale，不是只用于评测的基准。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
ToolScale serializes difficult tool-routing scenarios with initial state and evaluation actions, supplying the task substrate for ToolOrchestra training. Relative to agent training on generic tool-use prompts without cost-aware evaluation, it changes the reusable target to id, task description, user scenario, initial state, and evaluation criteria and makes environment evaluation criteria plus outcome, efficiency, and user-preference rewards the feedback boundary, so the central contribution is Track 01 data rather than a model-only, verifier-only, or benchmark-only artifact.

title: Method
方法
html:
Step 1 - Source and normalize the task. Input: synthetic hard tasks designed around heterogeneous models and tools. Operation: Normalize prompts, source identifiers, media or tools, references, and expected outputs into candidate records. Output and transition: Auditable candidates advance to target generation. Check / stop rule: Reject a candidate when its task input, source, access terms, or required reference is missing.

Step 2 - Write the reusable target. Input: A normalized candidate and its source evidence. Operation: a task-generation pipeline writes scenarios, initial states, and executable evaluation criteria. Output and transition: The resulting answer, rationale, or tool trace is serialized as id, task description, user scenario, initial state, and evaluation criteria and advances to verification. Check / stop rule: Stop when the target cannot be linked to its prompt, authoring mechanism, or required environment state.

Step 3 - Verify and package. Input: Generated targets and task-specific correctness metadata. Operation: Apply environment evaluation criteria plus outcome, efficiency, and user-preference rewards. Output and transition: Passing records form 4,063 synthetic tool-orchestration tasks stored as Parquet records and advance to training. Check / stop rule: Reject failed checks; final-answer agreement alone is not treated as proof that every intermediate step is correct.

Step 4 - Train and evaluate the consumer. Input: The pinned dataset revision and the paper's base checkpoint. Operation: Use the records for reinforcement learning and task-conditioned orchestration training and compare with agent training on generic tool-use prompts without cost-aware evaluation. Output and transition: A trained consumer and the paper's controlled evaluation become the final artifacts. Check / stop rule: Pin the data, teacher, tools, prompts, model, seeds, and harness, and do not generalize beyond evaluated domains.

步骤 1：取得并规范任务。输入是围绕异构模型和工具合成的困难任务。操作是统一题目、来源、媒体或工具、参考信息与预期输出。输出是可审计候选，随后进入目标生成。检查与停止规则是缺少任务输入、来源、使用条款或必要参考时立即拒绝。

步骤 2：写入可复用目标。输入是规范候选及其来源证据。操作是由任务生成流程编写场景、初始状态与可执行评估条件。输出是按“任务编号、描述、用户场景、初始状态和评估条件”序列化的答案、推理或工具轨迹，随后进入验证。检查与停止规则是目标无法对应题目、生成机制或必要环境状态时停止。

步骤 3：验证并打包。输入是生成目标与任务专用正确性信息。操作是执行环境评估条件以及结果、效率和用户偏好奖励。输出是通过检查的4063 个合成工具编排任务，按官方格式保存并进入训练。检查与停止规则是拒绝失败记录，且不把终答一致当作每个中间步骤都正确的证明。

步骤 4：训练并评估消费方。输入是固定版本的数据与论文基础检查点。操作是用于强化学习与任务条件化工具编排训练，并与缺少成本感知评估的通用工具提示训练比较。输出是训练后模型和受控评测。检查与停止规则是固定数据、教师、工具、提示、模型、随机种子与评测器，结论不越过已评估领域。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Decisive downstream experiment: On HLE, the 8B Orchestrator reports 37.1% versus GPT-5 at 35.1% while being 2.5x more efficient; the result couples ToolScale with the paper's multi-objective RL recipe. This is evidence for the complete data intervention under the reported training setup, not proof that every released record is correct.

Artifact check: the official release contains 4,063 synthetic tool-orchestration tasks and exposes actual fields id, task description, user scenario, initial state, and evaluation criteria; on 2026-07-27 its page reported 1768 downloads. Usage is only an impact cross-check, not a causal experiment.

决定性下游实验：在 HLE 上，8B Orchestrator 报告 37.1%，GPT-5 为 35.1%，且前者效率高 2.5 倍；结果同时包含 ToolScale 与多目标强化学习的作用。 这只能支持论文报告训练设置下的完整数据干预，不能证明每条公开记录都正确。

产物核验：官方发布包含4063 个合成工具编排任务，实际字段是“任务编号、描述、用户场景、初始状态和评估条件”；2026-07-27 数据页显示 1768 次下载。使用量只作影响交叉检查，不是因果实验。

title: Novelty
新意
html: The closest baseline is agent training on generic tool-use prompts without cost-aware evaluation. The paper changes the reusable object by making id, task description, user scenario, initial state, and evaluation criteria explicit and coupling it to environment evaluation criteria plus outcome, efficiency, and user-preference rewards. That is a direction signal because another team can train reinforcement learning and task-conditioned orchestration training from the released records. The inherited backbone, source tasks, autoregressive objective, and public benchmarks are not new.
最近基线是缺少成本感知评估的通用工具提示训练。真正变化是把“任务编号、描述、用户场景、初始状态和评估条件”显式化，并与“环境评估条件以及结果、效率和用户偏好奖励”绑定。另一团队可直接用公开记录训练强化学习与任务条件化工具编排训练，因此它构成数据方向信号。继承的骨干、来源任务、自回归目标和公开基准并不新。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. When evaluation criteria can reward benchmark-specific tool routing rather than general planning, the most serious consequence is training on a trace whose apparent correctness does not match its reasoning; reproduce a stratified record-level audit before reuse.
  2. Because tool prices, APIs, and model capabilities drift after data release, downstream gains may not transfer to a new domain or deployment; run source- and domain-specific evaluations rather than relying on the aggregate score.
  3. Reuse must preserve NVIDIA dataset license and every upstream source or media term; exclude records whose provenance or redistribution right cannot be reconstructed.

1. 如果评估条件可能奖励基准专用路由而非通用规划，最严重后果是把表面正确但推理不实的轨迹用于训练；复用前应按来源和难度分层抽样复核。
  2. 由于工具价格、接口和模型能力会在发布后漂移，汇总收益未必迁移到新领域或部署环境；应分别运行来源级和领域级评测。
  3. 复用必须遵守 NVIDIA dataset license 及全部上游来源或媒体条款；无法重建来源和再分发权利的记录应排除。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
• For teams building reinforcement learning and task-conditioned orchestration training, pin the official revision, preserve source fields, train a fixed-backbone baseline, and output both a versioned mixture and domain-level metrics. The intervention succeeds only if the target gains survive a provenance and error audit.
  • For auditors, sample records by source and difficulty and replay environment evaluation criteria plus outcome, efficiency, and user-preference rewards. Produce a keep/reject ledger with failure reasons; do not use the dataset when licenses, task inputs, or verification artifacts are unavailable.

• 构建强化学习与任务条件化工具编排训练的团队应固定官方版本、保留来源字段、训练同骨干基线，并输出带版本的数据混合与分领域指标。只有目标收益通过来源和错误审计后，才算复用成功。
  • 数据审计者应按来源和难度抽样，重放环境评估条件以及结果、效率和用户偏好奖励，输出带失败原因的保留与拒绝台账。许可、任务输入或验证产物缺失时不应使用。

阅读笔记

  • Reuse decision: suitable for reinforcement learning and task-conditioned orchestration training; first audit evaluation criteria can reward benchmark-specific tool routing rather than general planning and tool prices, APIs, and model capabilities drift after data release.

• 定位：ToolScale 把 4063 个困难工具编排任务写成场景、初始状态与评估条件，供小型编排器训练。

  • 证据锚点：在 HLE 上，8B Orchestrator 报告 37.1%，GPT-5 为 35.1%，且前者效率高 2.5 倍；结果同时包含 ToolScale 与多目标强化学习的作用。
  • 复用决定：适合强化学习与任务条件化工具编排训练；先审计评估条件可能奖励基准专用路由而非通用规划和工具价格、接口和模型能力会在发布后漂移。
